scope: Rescue applications built only with kernel_gui or debug: compile matrix, ten-profile debug + xmake test, release with and without kernel_gui, release boots, sizes against 7ddd8bb.
claims: all ten debug kernels pass xmake test
all ten release kernels (no kernel_gui) build and boot to status=ready
kernel_gui release builds link the rescue applications (x86_64, arm32, ppc, rv64)
release .text shrinks on every profile against 7ddd8bb

sources.relation: blob-identical to the commit (every tracked file)

sources.why_not_read: docs/BUILD.md, docs/PLAN.md and src/rescue/README.md: documentation no command here reads

environment.xmake: xmake v3.1.1+HEAD.3ba37a0, A cross-platform build utility based on Lua
environment.systoolchain: SysToolchain 0.1.0 release archives (one per triple), installed with --systoolchain_dir

commands.label: compile src/user/runtime.cpp src/user/runtime/*.cpp (all)
commands.command: for mode in release,debug; for each profile: <compile-flags.json[<mode>-<profile>]> -fsyntax-only <each of src/user/runtime.cpp src/user/runtime/*.cpp>  # run from the tree root

commands.label: compile src/user/runtime.cpp src/user/runtime/*.cpp (signal-fixture)
commands.command: for mode in debug; for each profile: <compile-flags.json[<mode>-<profile>]> -DOK_PRIVATE_SIGNAL_DELIVERY_FIXTURE -fsyntax-only <each of src/user/runtime.cpp src/user/runtime/*.cpp>  # run from the tree root

commands.label: compile src/user/runtime.cpp src/user/runtime/*.cpp (futex-fixture)
commands.command: for mode in debug; for each profile: <compile-flags.json[<mode>-<profile>]> -DOK_PRIVATE_FUTEX_PEER_FIXTURE -fsyntax-only <each of src/user/runtime.cpp src/user/runtime/*.cpp>  # run from the tree root
